ic_method: Spearman rank correlation; mean monthly rank IC
missing_value_policy: Unavailable diagnostics remain null/NaN; no metric is imputed or invented.
sector_concentration_method: Latest-date share of total absolute alpha by sector; the audit records the largest sector and its share when available.
sector_neutralization_method: Within each rebalance date and sector, subtract the sector mean and divide by the sector sample standard deviation; sectors require at least three available stocks.
selection_protocol: Prefer point-in-time SEC signals over static baselines.
Emphasize 63D performance only when consistent across rank IC, Q5-Q1 spread, positive-spread rate, and robustness checks.
Prefer factors with strong Q5-Q1 spread and positive spread rate.
Prefer factors that remain positive after sector neutralization.
Do not select a factor from a single p-value.
Do not add an opaque composite score or expand the factor search.
spread_definition: Mean monthly Q5 minus Q1 forward return
